verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an identity-verification SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that per-check results can be retrieved through the API by webhook or polling. That is a developer building block, not a documented bulk export of all account data in open formats or an offboarding path. No first-party export, data-portability or account-exit capability appears in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
